title: Length of Last Word
description:
Given a string s consisting of words and spaces, return the length of the last word in the string.
A word is a maximal substring consisting of non-space characters only.

examples.example_text:
Input: s = "Hello World"
Output: 5
Explanation: The last word is "World" with length 5.

Input: s = "   fly me   to   the moon  "
Output: 4
Explanation: The last word is "moon" with length 4.

Input: s = "luffy is still joyboy"
Output: 6
Explanation: The last word is "joyboy" with length 6.

constraints: s consists of only English letters and spaces ' '.
There will be at least one word in s.

test_snippets.python3:
def check(candidate):
    assert candidate(s = "Hello World") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "   fly me   to   the moon  ") == 4
    assert candidate(s = "luffy is still joyboy") == 6
    assert candidate(s = "    a    ") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "multiple   spaces   between   words") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "multiple    spaces    between    words") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "    word1    word2    word3    ") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "word1 word2  word3   word4    word5") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "longwordwithnospaces") == 20
    assert candidate(s = "trailing    spaces   ontheend    ") == 8
    assert candidate(s = "a ") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "Multiple     spaces     between     words") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "trailing spaces    ") == 6
    assert candidate(s = " ") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "oneTwoThree") == 11
    assert candidate(s = "   leading and trailing spaces   ") == 6
    assert candidate(s = "    leading spaces") == 6
    assert candidate(s = "noSpacesHere") == 12
    assert candidate(s = "special!@#$%^&*()characters") == 27
    assert candidate(s = "\tword\twith\ttabs\t") == 16
    assert candidate(s = "   a    b   c    d   ") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "word1 word2 word3 word4word5") == 10
    assert candidate(s = "") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "   oneTwoThree   ") == 11
    assert candidate(s = "singleword") == 10
    assert candidate(s = "   longwordwithnospaces   ") == 20
    assert candidate(s = "    very    very    very    long    string    with    many    spaces    in    between    words    ") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "   SingleWord   ") == 10
    assert candidate(s = "one") == 3
    assert candidate(s = "onewordwithpunctuation!") == 23
    assert candidate(s = "   multiple      spaces     between   words   ") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "   ") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "     onlyspaces    ") == 10
    assert candidate(s = "multiple     spaces    between words") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "   special!@#$%^&*()characters   ") == 27
    assert candidate(s = "word1word2word3") == 15
    assert candidate(s = "   a   ") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "Python     programming    language") == 8
    assert candidate(s = "   Leading and trailing spaces   ") == 6
    assert candidate(s = "   a    b   c   d   e   f   g   h   i   j   k   l   m   n   o   p   q   r   s   t   u   v   w   x   y   z   ") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "word with special@characters!") == 19
    assert candidate(s = "word\nwith\nnewlines") == 18
    assert candidate(s = "word1 word2 word3") == 5
    assert candidate(s = "SingleWord") == 10
    assert candidate(s = "     ") == 0
    assert candidate(s = "a") == 1
    assert candidate(s = "    verylongwordwithoutspaces    ") == 25
    assert candidate(s = "another-word-with-hyphens") == 25
